o: Who does the House of Flowers belong to?
Who built the House of Flowers?
questions.e: In the video: "Kome pripada Kuća cveća?" — Who does the House of Flowers belong to?

questions.q: What kind of land was the House of Flowers built on?
questions.e: In the video: "izgrađena na privatnom zemljištu" — built on private land.

questions.q: Who owned the land before the war?
o: The engineer and mayor Miloš Savčić
questions.e: In the video: "pripadalo čuvenom inženjeru i gradonačelniku Beograda Milošu Savčiću" — belonged to the famous engineer and mayor of Belgrade Miloš Savčić.

questions.q: In what year did the state take his family's property?
questions.e: In the video: "Njegovoj porodici država je oduzela imovinu 1946. godine" — the state confiscated his family's property in 1946.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Kuća cveća je izgrađena na privatnom *zemljištu*.
questions.e: Zemljište — a plot of land; zemljištu — loc. case.

questions.q: koje je pre Drugog svetskog rata pripadalo *čuvenom* inženjeru
Njegovoj porodici država je *oduzela* imovinu 1946. godine
koje je pre *Drugog* svetskog rata pripadalo čuvenom inženjeru

questions.e: The subject Kuća is 3rd pers. sg.: pripada.

questions.q: Kuća ___ je izgrađena na privatnom zemljištu.
questions.e: The name Kuća cveća — "House of Flowers", genitive: cveća.
Gradonačelnik (of what?) takes the genitive: Beograda.
Oduzeti (from whom?) takes the dative: porodici.
